ref_text: Dispatch to all units, we have a red sports car doing over a hundred on Interstate 9, heading north. Units twelve and fifteen, set up a roadblock at the bridge. Suspect is not stopping. Repeat, suspect is not stopping.

voices.dispatcher: A seasoned male police dispatcher in his forties with a deep, slightly gravelly American voice, speaking over a police radio during a car chase: fast, clipped and matter-of-fact, calm authority with an edge of urgency, crisp consonants.
voices.trooper: A tough American highway patrol officer, male, mid-thirties, mid-low pitch, speaking into a handheld radio from a speeding cruiser: urgent, clipped, loud and commanding, a little breathless.
voices.sergeant: A gruff veteran police sergeant, male, in his fifties, low raspy voice, terse and commanding, speaking quickly over the radio with controlled intensity.
voices.dispatch-woman: A female American police dispatcher around forty, alto voice, cool and professional, rapid clipped radio cadence, steady and unflappable under pressure.
